// Complete sampling state for reading a texture: per-axis wrap modes, the
// filter, the maximum anisotropy ratio (1 disables), a mip level-of-detail
// bias, and the border color used by ClampToBorder.

type TextureSampler
    implements IValue
{
    WrapU: WrapMode;
    WrapV: WrapMode;
    WrapW: WrapMode;
    Filter: FilterMode;
    Anisotropy: Number;
    MipBias: Number;
    BorderColor: Color;
}
